description: SYNTHETIC test collection for VAMORA personal-memory retrieval. 'Fatima Bano' is a fictional persona invented for evaluation; no real person's data is included. Authored by the system developer (see eval/README.md for the authoring protocol and its limitations).

documents.title: Hina
documents.text: Your daughter. She is a teacher and lives in Lahore with her husband Faisal. She calls you every evening.

documents.title: Imran
documents.text: Your son. He works as an engineer in Dubai and comes home for Eid.

documents.title: Rashid
documents.text: Your husband. He was a postman for thirty years. He passed away peacefully in 2015.

documents.title: Zainab
documents.text: Your granddaughter, Hina's daughter. She is ten and loves drawing pictures for you.

documents.title: Bushra
documents.text: Your neighbour next door. She brings vegetables from her garden on Fridays.

documents.title: Dr. Saleem
documents.text: Your family doctor at City Clinic. He is kind and speaks slowly.

documents.title: Kamran
documents.text: Your younger brother. He lives in Sialkot and phones on Sundays.

documents.title: Shabana
documents.text: The nurse who comes every morning to help you get ready.

documents.title: Home in Gujrat
documents.text: Your house on Kutchery Road with a white gate and a mango tree in the courtyard.

documents.title: Hina's house in Lahore
documents.text: A flat near Model Town park. You stayed there in the winter.

documents.title: Childhood village
documents.text: You grew up in a village near Sialkot, beside the river, where you swam with Kamran.

documents.title: Jamia Masjid
documents.text: The mosque at the end of your street. You can hear the azan from the courtyard.

documents.title: City Clinic
documents.text: Dr. Saleem's clinic on the second floor above the chemist.

documents.title: Wedding to Rashid
documents.text: You married Rashid in Sialkot. There was rain in the morning and dhol in the evening.

documents.title: Hina's graduation
documents.text: Hina finished her degree at Punjab University. You wore your green shawl.

documents.title: Zainab was born
documents.text: Your first grandchild was born in Lahore. You held her in the hospital.

documents.title: Hajj with Rashid
documents.text: You performed Hajj together in Makkah.

documents.title: Imran's wedding
documents.text: Imran married Sana in Gujrat. The whole family danced.

documents.title: Retirement from school
documents.text: You retired after thirty-five years of teaching. Your pupils gave you a clock.

documents.title: Eid 2023 at home
documents.text: Everyone came home for Eid: Hina, Imran, Sana and Zainab.

documents.title: Morning tea
documents.text: Tea with milk and a toast after you wake up.

documents.title: Breakfast medicines
documents.text: Shabana helps you with the blue pill box after breakfast.

documents.title: Walk in the courtyard
documents.text: A slow walk around the courtyard, ten rounds.

documents.title: Zuhr prayer
documents.text: Midday prayer on your prayer mat by the window.

documents.title: Afternoon rest
documents.text: Lie down for an hour after lunch.

documents.title: Watering the plants
documents.text: Water the mango tree and the rose pots.

documents.title: Phone call with Hina
documents.text: Hina calls you every evening to talk about your day.

documents.title: Bedtime
documents.text: Lock the white gate and have a glass of warm milk before sleeping.

documents.title: Favourite food
documents.text: Saag with makki ki roti, and kheer on special days.

documents.title: My teaching years
documents.text: I taught Urdu to class three at the Government Girls School.

documents.title: Rashid's poems
documents.text: Rashid wrote poems for me. The notebook is in the steel trunk.

documents.title: Where things are kept
documents.text: Glasses on the bedside table. House keys on the hook by the door.

documents.title: Favourite songs
documents.text: Noor Jehan songs on the old radio.

documents.title: Embroidery
documents.text: I love stitching. I made quilts for each grandchild.

documents.title: Moti
documents.text: Moti is our grey cat. She likes sleeping on the charpai in the sun.
